title: Sicilian Chickpea Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful twist on traditional chickpea fritters, inspired by Sicilian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, mash the chickpeas using a fork.
Add the flour, yummy, salt, and black pepper to the bowl. Mix well.
Gradually add the crushed puffs to the bowl and mix until a thick dough forms.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
